title: plugin-security + organizations: the seed-ownership claims re-own rows with one filter-matched bulk update, which the engine refuses when a stored expression reads `owner_id`, so every seeded row of that object stays ownerless
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 种子数据的「认领负责人」用一条批量更新把无主的种子行一次性交给管理员。如果对象上有一个存储型计算字段读了 `owner_id`（例如标题里带负责人姓名），每一行算出的值不同，引擎拒绝这条批量更新，于是该对象的所有种子行都没有负责人。
- **要做：** 两处认领（`plugin-security` 与 `organizations`）在存储表达式依赖 `owner_id` 时按 id 逐行（或按计算值分批）认领；或者引擎对这种批量更新逐行结算。
- **完成标准：** 带此类存储字段的对象，启动后种子行全部有负责人，启动日志没有 `claimSeedOwnership failed`。

Filing gate **① a measured defect**, found by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) while executing objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2242 (claim comment `6385127610`). That card is `pm:blocked` on this one. ⛔ Not a claim.

`reach:` a real producer: HotCRM's `crm_forecast.display_title`, a stored expression that reads `record.owner_id.name`, on a fresh boot of the app on `@objectstack/*` 18.1.0. All 7 seeded forecasts stay ownerless (measured below).

**Suggested grade: `priority:p2`** (the seat's reading; `priority`, `domain:*` and `area:*` are triage's). Seeded rows lose their owner silently: the boot only logs a warning. It hits any app whose stored expression depends on `owner_id`. The one-hop read is supported, so this is a shape authors will write.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage, then the lane that owns `packages/plugins/plugin-security` and `packages/plugins/organizations` (or the engine lane, if triage picks the engine option). The downstream reader is the `repo:hotcrm` seat, which resumes objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2242 once a release carries the fix.

## Measured

On `@objectstack/*` 18.1.0, HotCRM `origin/main` `a4b3560`, on 2026-10-24. Both runs boot the app on a fresh DB and count owners after seeding. A is HotCRM `main`. B is the same tree with one change: `display_title` reads the owner's name through the lookup.

| | `crm_forecast.display_title` expression | forecasts seeded | ownerless | `crm_account` (control) ownerless |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| A (`main`) | `record.period_label + " (" + string(record.period_start) + ")"` | 7 | **0** | 0 / 9 |
| B (patched) | `record.?owner_id.?name.orValue("") == "" ? record.period_label : record.period_label + " · " + record.?owner_id.?name.orValue("")` | 7 | **7** | 0 / 9 |

The boot log for B:

```text
WARN Update operation failed {"object":"crm_forecast","error":{"message":"'display_title' on 'crm_forecast' is computed from its expression on every write, and this update changes its inputs on rows where it then computes different values, which one update of all the matched rows cannot store; update those rows by id, so each is computed from its own row", ... at settleBulkStoredExpressions (@objectstack/objectql/dist/index.mjs:11060) ...}}
WARN [security] claimSeedOwnership failed for crm_forecast; those rows stay unowned until the claim next runs ... {"object":"crm_forecast","where":{"owner_id":null,"id":{"$in":"7 id(s)"}}, ...}
```

The expression itself works: inserts and by-id updates in the same run titled rows `Q4 2026 · Nina Reyes` and `Q4 2026 · Omar Diaz`. Only the bulk claim fails. Re-running the claim does not help, because the next run sends the same bulk update.

## Where it lands (read on objectstack `origin/main` `2c523d0100`)

Engine (behaviour the claims run into, correct as documented):
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` `planStoredExpressions` (:3044) and `resolveFormulaRelated` (:7073). A stored expression may read one hop through a lookup.
- `settleBulkStoredExpressions` (:3191–3219), called for a filter-matched update at :19425. A computed value that moves to different values on different rows is refused, and the message at :3212–3214 says "update those rows by id".

The two claims, both one `multi: true` update over a predicate:
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/claim-seed-ownership.ts`:
  - `unownedPredicates` (:296–303) builds `{ owner_id: null, id: { $in: <page of seeded ids> } }`, plus `{ owner_id: SystemUserId.SYSTEM }`.
  - `reown` (:635–639) is `ql.update(schema.name, { owner_id: adminUserId }, { where: predicate, multi: true, … })`.
  - The paging fallback in `claimPredicate` (:430) is the same bulk shape, `reown({ id: { $in: ids } })`.
  - The per-predicate `catch` (:654–668) logs `[security] claimSeedOwnership failed for …` and moves on.
- `packages/plugins/organizations/src/claim-org-seed-ownership.ts`:
  - `reown` (:260–264) is `ql.update(schema.name, { owner_id: ownerUserId }, { where, multi: true, … })`.
  - It is called per chunk with `{ organization_id, owner_id: null, id: { $in: <chunk> } }` (:266–274, through `claimChunk` :167).
  - Same pattern, found by reading. Not measured: HotCRM runs single-tenant and does not install the organizations plugin.

## Ask

- When an object's stored expressions depend on `owner_id`, the two seed-ownership claims re-own row by id, or batch the rows by computed value so each bulk update stores one value.
- Optional, the engine-side alternative: `settleBulkStoredExpressions` settles such a bulk update per row instead of refusing it. Triage picks which side owns it.
- A row that cannot be claimed stays reported as today.

## Done when

- A pin for each claim: an object with a stored expression reading `owner_id` (direct, and one hop through the lookup) and two or more seeded rows that compute different values. After the claim, every row is owned and the stored value matches its row.
- HotCRM's patched `display_title` (row B above) boots with 0 ownerless forecasts on the release carrying the fix.

**Size:** S–M.

## Context, not asked here

A stored title that reads a lookup goes stale when the lookup target is renamed. The probe renamed the owner (`sys_user.name`, `Nina Reyes` → `Nina Reyes-Park`, written through the driver). The forecast still read `Q4 2026 · Nina Reyes`. The next by-id `PATCH` of the forecast (`commit_amount` only) recomputed it to `Q4 2026 · Nina Reyes-Park`. This matters to whoever designs lookup-reading stored expressions. This card does not ask for anything on it.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectstack issue (123; 123 + 25 open PRs = `open_issues_count` 148) and every issue updated since 2026-10-10T10:04Z (1457, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged by hand) on 2026-10-24, and matched case-insensitively on title and body. The search API is refused for this session. Words: `claimSeedOwnership`, `claimOrgSeedOwnership`, `seed ownership`, `settleBulkStoredExpressions`, `update those rows by id`, `stored expression`, `stored computed`, `multi: true`, `bulk update`, `resolveFormulaRelated`, `planStoredExpressions`, `dot-walk`, `one hop`. Nearest hits, all closed and none on this interaction: #23008, #23054, #23354 and #23599 (the claims' context, cap and scope), #25204 (`claimOrphanOrgRows`), #24690, #25000 and #25073 (stored expressions). **New.**
